To determine the specific years Marcus Aurelius lived, we refer to the paragraph about him: "Marcus Aurelius ( ; Latin: 'Marcus Aurelius Antoninus Augustus' ; 26 April 121 – 17 March 180 AD) was Roman emperor from , ruling jointly with Lucius Verus until Verus' death in 169 and jointly with his son, Commodus, from 177." This indicates that Marcus Aurelius lived from 121 AD to 180 AD.

FINDING: Marcus Aurelius lived from 121 AD to 180 AD.
